messages.subject: Re: ggplot Multiple Regression Lines
parts:
You've given each woman a unique identifier so there is only one data
point per person. It's hard to fit a line to one point ;)

Hadley

messages.author: f20966e9bc9cf5c7
messages.subject: Re: ggplot Multiple Regression Lines
parts: I am guessing you have too many "group"s. "id" should be a meaningful factor with which one can perform a regression. This example is not reproducible so I/we can't help you much further (if I have helped you at all).

El 26 de enero de 2017 19:56:08 CET, Timothy Lau <timoth...@gmail.com> escribió:
Hi,

I'm trying to make a single plot with multiple regression lines.
This code example doesn't work. 


women2 <- data.frame(id = 1:nrow(women), women)
ggplot(data = women2, mapping = aes(x = height, y = weight, group = id)) + geom_smooth(method = lm, se = F)

What should I change?
